arabic text: AY MAA TUM MUJHE PAAS BULALO MUJHE PYAAS SATATI HE\nTURBAT SE ALI ASGHAR KI AWAAZ YE AATI HEY
english translation text: O MOTHER BRING ME CLOSE TO YOU, THE THIRST IS MAKING ME SUFFER\nFROM THE GRAVE COMES ALI ASGHAR'S VOICE

arabic text: YAAD AAYE BOHOT MUJHKO TERA JHULA JHULANA\nHYY, KABHI SEENE SE LAGA KE TERA LORI SUNANA\nJAB RAYT GARAM PYAARI MAA - MERE TAN KO JALAATI HEY
english translation text: I AM REMINDED OF YOU ROCKING MY CRADLE\nOH, SOMETIMES BEING HELD CLOSE TO YOUR CHEST LISTENING TO YOU SING A LULLABY\nWHEN THE HOT SAND O' MOTHER BURNS MY BODY

arabic text: HAYE PYAAS KI SHIDDAT SE GALA SUKHA PARHA HEY\nHYY, HEY ZAKHMI GALA USME AY MAA DARD KHARA HEY\nTURBAT ME AKELA HU(N) MEY - TANHAAI DARAATI HEY
english translation text: MY THROAT IS PARCHED FROM THE INTENSE THIRST\nOH, MY WOUNDED NECK O' MOTHER IS RACKED WITH PAIN\nI AM ALONE IN THE GRAVE TERRIFIED BY THE LONELINESS

arabic text: JHULE MEY PARHA ASGHAR DIN RAAT HEY ROYA\nHYY, JAB PYAAS BUJHI ISKI TO PHIR CHEYN SE SOYA\nMAQTAL MEY SAKINA PHIR KYUN - ISE DHOOND NE JAATI HEY
english translation text: ASGHAR LAY IN THE CRADLE CRYING DAY AND NIGHT\nOH, HE SLEPT SOUNDLY ONLY WHEN HIS THIRST WAS QUENCHED\nTHEN WHY IS SAKINA SEARCHING FOR HIM IN THE BATTLEFIELD

arabic text: DARWAAZE PE KHAIMA KE YE IK BIBI KHAR(R)I HEY\nHAYE, MUR MUR KE JO MAQTAL KI TARAF DEKH RAHI HEY\nIK KHOON BHAREY CHOLE KO - AANKHO SEY LAGAATI HEY
english translation text: A LADY IS STANDING AT THE TENT'S ENTRANCE\nOH, SHE IS DESPERATELY GAZING TOWARDS THE BATTLEFIELD\nSHE IS PRESSING A BLOOD SOAKED CLOTH AGAINST HER EYES

arabic text: WO SHAME GHARIBA KO AJAB ZULM HUWA THA\nHYY, SAR NANGE THI HAR BIBI HAR IK KHAIMA JALAA THA\nABBAS KA SAANIY-E-ZAHRA - HYY FARZ NIBHAATI HEY
english translation text: ZAINAB IS CONDUCTING ABBAS'S DUTIES\nON SHAME GHARIBA A TERRIBLE OPPRESSION OCCURRED\nOH, ALL THE LADIES WERE BARE HEADED AND THE TENTS WERE BURNT

arabic text: AKHTAR YE HAWAAO NE JO PAIGHAAM DIYA HEY\nHYY, ASGHAR TUJHE SUGHRA NE BOHOT YAAD KIYA HEY\nIK BAAR MADINE AAWO - BEMAAR BULAATI HEY
english translation text: OH, ASGHAR SUGHRA IS REMEMBERING YOU\nTHESE WINDS HAVE BROUGHT A MESSAGE, AKHTAR\nCOME BACK TO MADINA YOUR ILL(SISTER) IS CALLING YOU

arabic text: AY MAA TUM MUJHE PAAS BULAALO MUJHE PYAASSATAATI HEY
english translation text: O MOTHER, CALL ME BACK TO YOU,\nTHIRST HAS BECOME UNBEARABLE
